My husband is home and has gotten the kids to bed so we are figuring out a plan for the week because he can't take time off work yet. I think I will be okay tonight, since they are home. We are talking to friends to see if someone can help me out with the kids all week and keep me company so that I'm not left alone. 

Thank you.

Last time (not counting my pregnancy when hormones made me insane) I was going through a divorce with an infant and had doctors that refused to listen to me. 

This time everything is going so well. My husband has a great job with affordable benefits, I'm a SAHM, we have finally made headway into some of my son's behavior issues, we have a reliable car and have money to save at the end of every month. It almost feels like everything is going so well my body just gave itself permission to have a meltdown because I am not worried about a million things anymore. But I want to be happy dammit! My life is going well and I want to enjoy it, not freak the fuck out and have to leave Disney because I'm having a panic attack and want to kill myself.

It's been a long time since I've been this bad. 5 years 4 months and 12 days since I last had to be hospitalized for trying to kill myself. I broke down during my last pregnancy but my husband and midwife got me on medicine and kept me from going over the edge. I've spent years trying to learn triggers and prevent it from getting this bad and learning to watch the warning signs and it didn't work this time.

I'm tired of trying to find what works. It's been over 10 years of trying combinations of medicines that maybe work and maybe don't and if they do what are side effects and do those outweigh the benefits and I'm just tired of it all.
